additional_concerns: The source assigns continuing responsibility but supplies no complete test for effective retention or discharge through supervision. Governance, practical authority and conduct are possible evidence, not source-established necessary or sufficient conditions. The candidate's uncertainty between retention and fulfillment must remain unresolved.

Proper ownership records and operational compatibility are separately required by the supplied record-keeping provision. Retention alone establishes neither those outcomes nor overall compliance; an operational failure alone does not establish loss of accountability.

Paragraph 14 places the request trigger directly on demonstration, leaving confirmation unconditioned. Footnote 5 supplies minimum substantive content and high-confidence smart-contract assurance, while its unqualified confirm-and-demonstrate wording leaves interpretive tension over demonstration timing and the reach of the SFC-satisfaction standard. No request does not establish fulfillment or remove confirmation.
Paragraphs 15 and 16 expressly condition obtaining third-party audit or verification and satisfactory legal opinion on an SFC request. They do not supply an unconditional retention test.

Section 6.11C concerns third-party valuation. Its care, selection, monitoring and review standards cannot automatically become the general Product Provider retention test. The register-address notification duty likewise remains distinct.
No executable expressions or assessed facts are supplied. This review establishes neither an implementation defect nor satisfaction or failure of the candidate requirement.
